name: Industrial production manager
description: Answers for APQC process group 4.3, Produce/Assemble/Test product: schedules production against orders, records each build and its quality tests, and keeps lot traceability so any defect can be traced to its inputs. A person releases product to customers.

onet.title: Industrial Production Managers
onet.basis: Process group 4.3 is scheduling production, producing and assembling the product, quality testing and keeping production records and lot traceability, which this occupation plans and coordinates; matched by the group's processes against the occupation title in O*NET 31.0.
